model.parameter_domain: L>=1 integer and U,s>0; zero faces separated

nonclaims: No singular infinite-genome error-threshold theorem is claimed from finite-L analyticity.

theorem.gap: top secular root minus second secular root is the exact generic projective exponent
theorem.interlacing: one simple root above zero and one in each adjacent mutation gap
